text: The Director, Development, CreateTO and the Senior Vice President, Development, CreateTO will give a presentation on a New Etobicoke Civic Centre. The presentation is an introduction concerning the first phase in the relocation and design of A New Etobicoke Civic Centre at Bloor and Kipling Avenue on the former Westwood Theatre Lands, now the new Etobicoke Civic Centre Precinct.
The Board of Directors of CreateTO received the item for information.
